# Spider-Gwen Elise

Turn Elise into Spider-Gwen while keeping her original gameplay and ability logic.

### 📌 Mod Info

**Type:** Custom Skin  
**Modified Skin:** Base Elise

### ✨ What's Changed

- Human form remodelled to Spider-Gwen with a custom texture
- Spider form recoloured to match
- Ability and basic-attack VFX recoloured pink/blue → white, in both human and spider form
- Custom loading-screen artwork and in-game HUD portraits
- Custom Spider-Gwen voice-over (Marvel Heroes), loudness-matched to the
  originals: move, attack, taunt, joke and death replaced; laugh and all combat
  grunts silenced

### 🧾 Credits

**Model:** Spider-Gwen — https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/spider-gwen-8ced3414d0c947abac000f8d3de1aa0f
**Voice-over:** Spider-Gwen, *Marvel Heroes*  
The original assets were modified and adapted for this custom skin.
